pr.title: feature: add option to configure activity bar drag and drop

reviews.body:
## Pull request overview

Adds a new workbench setting intended to let users disable Activity Bar drag-and-drop (to prevent accidental reordering), wiring the setting into Activity Bar creation and plumbing a `draggable` flag down into composite bar creation.

**Changes:**
- Adds the `workbench.activityBar.dragAndDrop.enabled` boolean setting (default `true`).
- Threads a `draggable` parameter through `PaneCompositeBar.create` → `CompositeBar.create`.
- Reads the setting in `ActivityBarCompositeBar.create` and passes it into the composite bar creation path.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| src/vs/workbench/browser/workbench.contribution.ts | Registers the new `workbench.activityBar.dragAndDrop.enabled` setting. |
| src/vs/workbench/browser/parts/paneCompositeBar.ts | Adds a `draggable` parameter to `create` and forwards it to `CompositeBar`. |
| src/vs/workbench/browser/parts/compositeBar.ts | Adds a `draggable` parameter to `create` and forwards it to the action view item options. |
| src/vs/workbench/browser/parts/activitybar/activitybarPart.ts | Reads the new setting and passes it into `PaneCompositeBar.create`. |


<details>
<summary>Comments suppressed due to low confidence (1)</summary>

**src/vs/workbench/browser/parts/compositeBar.ts:304**
* The new `draggable` flag passed into `CompositeActionViewItem` won’t actually disable Activity Bar drag-and-drop: `CompositeActionViewItem.render()` always calls `CompositeDragAndDropObserver.registerDraggable(...)`, and `registerDraggable` force-sets `element.draggable = true` regardless of the action view item options. To make the setting effective, plumb the flag through and conditionally skip registering draggables/targets (e.g., guard the `registerDraggable` call in `CompositeActionViewItem` based on the passed option, and consider also skipping `registerTarget` in `CompositeBar.create` when disabled).
```
	create(parent: HTMLElement, draggable = true): HTMLElement {
		const actionBarDiv = parent.appendChild($('.composite-bar'));
		this.compositeSwitcherBar = this._register(new ActionBar(actionBarDiv, {
			actionViewItemProvider: (action, options) => {
				if (action instanceof CompositeOverflowActivityAction) {
					return this.compositeOverflowActionViewItem.value;
				}
				const item = this.model.findItem(action.id);
				return item && this.instantiationService.createInstance(
					CompositeActionViewItem,
					{ ...options, draggable, colors: this.options.colors, icon: this.options.icon, hoverOptions: this.options.activityHoverOptions, compact: this.options.compact },
					action as CompositeBarAction,
					item.pinnedAction,
					item.toggleBadgeAction,
					compositeId => this.options.getContextMenuActionsForComposite(compositeId),
					() => this.getContextMenuActions(),
					this.options.dndHandler,
					this
				);
```
</details>
